item.title: Energy announces $352M in funding for frontier science
item.description: The agency will make funding available to research teams looking to solve the scientific challenges underpinning next-generation energy technologies.

item.title: Potential US-built hacking tools obtained by foreign spies and cybercriminals, research says
item.description: iVerify has described the activity as the “first known mass iOS attack” campaign of its kind. Google said fragments of the exploit first appeared last February, with ties to an unnamed “customer of a surveillance company.”

item.title: Trump’s CISA nominee to exit Coast Guard role, but still in running to lead cyber agency
item.description: Sean Plankey has been serving in a Coast Guard advisory role for some months and is still set to be the nominee to lead CISA.

item.title: Iran-linked hacktivists could target governments, experts warn
item.description: State and local governments and some crucial technology infrastructure are among the key retaliatory targets as hostilities escalate in the Middle East.

item.title: Defense tech enters a new era: the case of Anthropic and the DOD
item.description: This dispute is likely to continue reverberating throughout the defense technology and policy worlds.

item.title: 7 tech companies commit to protect consumers from rising electricity prices
item.description: President Donald Trump’s Ratepayer Protection Pledge was announced during his State of the Union address and is intended to alleviate the burden of AI-related infrastructure costs.

item.title: Accessing Social Security disability benefits became harder in 2025, researchers find
item.description: Changes like the push to online servicing and introduction of AI on SSA phone lines made it difficult for certain recipients to access the agency.

item.title: House amendment responding to Pentagon-Anthropic conflict fails committee vote
item.description: Lawmakers split over an amendment to the Defense Production Act from Rep. Sam Liccardo, D-Calif., that would have prohibited the government from blacklisting firms opposed to their tech being used in certain situations.

item.title: IRS CEO largely dodges questions about data sharing at IRS, SSA
item.description: Frank Bisignano cited “current litigation” for why he could not provide further details about IRS data sharing with ICE, and he disputed court records detailing how DOGE employees handled data at SSA.

item.title: Trump’s CISA nominee said he left Coast Guard to address GOP hold
item.description: Sean Plankey confirmed the intent to Nextgov/FCW and said he’s “prepared to lead the nation’s cyber defense agency to protect the federal civilian networks and our nation’s critical infrastructure from physical and cyber attacks.”
